targets.C7_ranked_taxonomy: CIHP four checkpoints only; no Sapiens body rank while semantic ambiguity persists
supplementary: boundary quality conditional on valid match
targets.C3_scope: Fixed same-GT garment task with explicit partial native expressivity (Dress/Apparel unresolved errors), not a claim of identical native taxonomy

prediction_projection.primary: native hard-label output then deterministic lookup
prediction_projection.unresolved_known_native_labels: explicit rejection/error column, never GT ignore

domain.instance_mask_source: native Human_ids; original per-image IDs, no physical-identity certification

native_YOLO_association.algorithm: maximize valid pair cardinality, then total IoU, then stable immutable IDs

ROI_policy.common_proposed_geometry: QANet native aspect adjustment W/H=3/4, expansion1.25 around YOLO bbox center; Sapiens use equivalent continuous ROI geometry
ROI_policy.post_parse_ownership: intersect with corresponding frozen YOLO instance mask, restore original coordinates
ROI_policy.outside_image_padding: QANet native ROIAlign zero normalized sampling; Sapiens ImageNet-mean RGB constant proposed; record as route difference and test geometry parity
ROI_policy.native_augmentation: retain pinned native setting, do not force equal augmentation

evaluation_matching.prediction_mask: M2FP/D2FP: native human ownership extent before semantic labels; RP-R-CNN: union of native non-BG person parsing, no filled-bbox substitute; ROI systems: frozen YOLO instance extent, independent of semantic nonempty
evaluation_matching.assignment: eligible maximum cardinality then maximum total mask IoU, deterministic ID tie-break
evaluation_matching.empty_union: IoU=0; invalid empty native person entries must be diagnosed; no GT-person deletion

metrics.primary: Q_person_sem_GT for each fixed view and population
metrics.G_sem: GT persons with at least one valid target pixel, independent of predictions/execution success
metrics.person_macro_classes: union of target classes present in GT person or its matched prediction; nonempty because G_sem requires target GT
metrics.zero_union_global_classes: N/A with support counts; primary view requires all target classes supported at population level
metrics.valid_empty_prediction: execution success; scored as missed persons, not failure
metrics.absent_prediction_unresolved_label: error column on fixed valid GT; never ignored
metrics.known_empty_semantics: Keep available person location/identity. Do not reuse legacy helper filtering np.any(semantic_mask) without a new declared contract.

failure_policy.failed_images: retain INCOMPLETE rows, main metrics null; success-only diagnostics explicitly non-ranking
failure_policy.approved_resume_scope: only never-attempted jobs after exact input/config/checkpoint/source/recipe fingerprints and explicit continuation decision; cannot retry prior failed images or change membership
failure_policy.runtime_failure: runtime profile INCOMPLETE, retain quality evidence separately; no cost Pareto eligibility

runtime.hardware: Tesla T4 on assigned visible GPU
runtime.native_internal_operator_dtypes: retain and record; Sapiens native RoPE may use BF16, not strict-all-ops-FP32
runtime.batch: one frame / one sequential ROI; native TTA internal batching recorded
runtime.primary_route_residency: YOLO plus parser co-resident, possibly separate worker processes/frameworks; no simultaneous GPU compute
runtime.parser_component_timing: nested synchronized substage measurements within actual route, not separate extra passes
runtime.native_reference_residency: parser only, no YOLO model or other GPU process
runtime.included: input RGB in RAM -> preprocessing, transfers, forward, postprocess, IPC, association/map-back/composition
runtime.excluded: file read/JPEG decode, model initialization, visualization, metric scoring, prediction serialization/disk writes
summaries: per-person component and per-frame route units
memory: device-wide sampled peak used MiB at50ms; absolute and idle-baseline delta
runtime.resource_rank_scope: route device-sampled peak and actual route latency; native-reference ranks separate
runtime.population_weighted_mean: sum_h (N_h/N)*mean_frame_latency_h; parser ms/person estimated as weighted total parser component time divided by weighted total opportunities, not average of per-frame ratios

selection.eligible: accepted fixed task/support bindings + strict-complete quality; report runtime eligibility independently
selection.absolute_floor_reason: No application-validated threshold supplied; relative public checkpoint selection, not deployment acceptance
selection.near_tie_units: absolute0-1 metric difference =0.5 percentage points; proposed descriptive margin, not equivalence
selection.uncertainty: 1000 paired cluster bootstrap resamples by known exact decoded-RGB duplicate groups; fixed seed20261021; descriptive95percent interval, no independence claim for unobserved near duplicates
selection.rule: Within each task/route select best Q, report instance F1/FP, flag near ties, retain non-dominated Q/instance-F1/route-latency/device-sampled-memory configurations; no weighted score or forced universal winner

resource_caps_proposed.OOM: record failure; do not change precision/resolution/TTA to finish same run
